description:
We share simple, low-cost home repairs and checks that help homeowners over 60 keep older houses safe, dry and running well without overpaying. Our videos cover the jobs that matter most in aging homes, from drafts and damp to roofs and plumbing, with practical fixes that often cost a few dollars instead of a few thousand.

Much of what we teach comes from the old-school methods builders relied on long before expensive products and call-out fees, along with easy checks you can do yourself before calling in a professional. When a job does need an expert, we help you spot it early and know the right questions to ask.

If you want to protect your home and your savings, subscribe and join us.

videos.title: 12 Cheap Checks Retired Home Inspectors Do in Every Old House Before Winter
15 Old-House Tricks a Retired Home Inspector Teaches Owners Over 60 That Cost Pennies
